question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is **'Robery'**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling for the word is ***robbery ***which means the action of taking property unlawfully from a person or place by force or threat of force.
 
• The **meanings** of the other options are as follows - 
 
 
• **Rotten - **suffering from decay.
 
• **Rotate - **move or cause to move in a circle around an axis or center.
 
• **Round - **shaped like a circle or cylinder.
 
 
 
• Hence, **option 1 **is the correct answer.
